entries.meaning: n. 快艇；游艇；vi. 驾游艇；乘游艇
entries.example: They rented a small yacht for an afternoon along the coast.
entries.exampleTranslation: 他们租了一艘小游艇，沿着海岸度过了一个下午。

entries.example: Do not yank the cord; it may damage the machine.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不要猛拉这根电线，它可能会损坏机器。

entries.example: The children are playing in the yard.
entries.exampleTranslation: 孩子们正在院子里玩。

entries.example: She bought blue yarn to knit a scarf for winter.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她买了蓝色纱线来织一条冬天用的围巾。

entries.meaning: n. 哈欠；vi. 打哈欠；裂开
entries.example: A long meeting can make it hard to hide a yawn.
entries.exampleTranslation: 漫长的会议会让人难以掩饰哈欠。

entries.example: Yeah, I can meet you after work.
entries.exampleTranslation: 是的，我下班后可以见你。

entries.example: She will graduate next year.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她将于明年毕业。

entries.meaning: a. 每年的；一年一度的；adv. 一年一次；每年
entries.example: The club holds a yearly picnic for members and their families.
entries.exampleTranslation: 该俱乐部每年为会员及其家人举办一次野餐。

entries.meaning: vi. 渴望；想念；怀念；同情
entries.example: After years abroad, she began to yearn for the quiet streets of her hometown.
entries.exampleTranslation: 在国外多年后，她开始渴望家乡安静的街道。

entries.example: Mix the flour with water and yeast, then leave the dough to rise.
entries.exampleTranslation: 把面粉与水、酵母混合，然后让面团发酵。

entries.meaning: vi. 叫喊；大叫；(齐声)呐喊欢呼；vt. 喊叫着说
entries.example: Don't yell at the child; speak calmly.
entries.exampleTranslation: 不要冲孩子大叫；平静地说。

entries.example: She wore a yellow dress to the party.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她穿了一条黄裙子去参加聚会。

entries.meaning: n. 日元(日本货币单位)；渴望；嗜好；vi. 渴望
entries.example: The price of the imported camera rose to fifty thousand yen.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这台进口相机的价格上涨到了五万日元。

entries.example: Yes, I can come to your party.
entries.exampleTranslation: 是的，我可以来参加你的聚会。

entries.example: It rained heavily yesterday in our town.
entries.exampleTranslation: 昨天我们镇上下了大雨。

entries.meaning: adv. 还；尚；仍然；已经；然而；conj. 然而
entries.example: The bus has not arrived yet.
entries.exampleTranslation: 公交车还没有到。

entries.meaning: n. 生产量；投资收益；vt. 出产；给予；让出；放弃；使屈服
entries.example: The farm's corn yield doubled after the new irrigation system.
entries.exampleTranslation: 采用新的灌溉系统后，农场的玉米产量翻了一番。

entries.example: I added fresh berries and honey to a bowl of plain yogurt.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我在一碗原味酸乳酪中加了新鲜浆果和蜂蜜。

entries.example: The train from London to York takes about two hours.
entries.exampleTranslation: 从伦敦到约克的火车大约需要两小时。

entries.example: You can sit next to me.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你可以坐在我旁边。

entries.meaning: a. 年轻的；无经验的；朝气蓬勃的；n. 青年们；幼小动物；崽
entries.example: The young girl is reading a picture book.
entries.exampleTranslation: 那个小女孩正在读一本图画书。

entries.example: One youngster asked the coach how to improve his shooting.
entries.exampleTranslation: 一个少年问教练如何提高投篮水平。

entries.example: Your keys are on the dining table.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你的钥匙在餐桌上。

entries.meaning: pron. 你的(东西)；你们的(东西)
entries.example: This umbrella isn't mine; I think it is yours.
entries.exampleTranslation: 这把伞不是我的，我想是你的。

entries.example: You should be proud of yourself.
entries.exampleTranslation: 你应该为自己感到骄傲。

entries.example: Please help yourselves to more tea while we wait for the others.
entries.exampleTranslation: 我们等其他人的时候，请你们自己再喝点茶。

entries.meaning: n. 年轻；青年时代；青年们；青春
entries.example: In her youth, she traveled across Europe alone.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她年轻时独自游历了欧洲。

entries.example: Her youthful enthusiasm made the whole team feel more energetic during the long project.
entries.exampleTranslation: 她年轻的热情让整个团队在漫长的项目中感到更有活力。
